3165-3532-5078-8346.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2317-6495-7084-8345.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
2317-6495-7084-8345.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1283-1308-1651-2557-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Parallel Lives and Anointed Procession.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1308-1651-2557-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1981-2415-3641-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

5060-5078-7902.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
5060-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-3129-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Primal Vigor
Repeat.

3188-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

575-2034-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-2034-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Repeat from step 5.

250-779-1479-5413-6528.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-6528.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

2334-4772-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2334-4772-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

141-313-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-5231.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

413-3769-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
413-3769-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

148-4968-6822.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat.

2060-3705-6701-6798.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Squee.
When Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
2060-3705-6701-6798.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

632-1849-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1849-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

803-3951-5703-5921.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-1003-1329-2178.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
413-1003-1329-2178.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1494-6113.notablePrerequisites:
Sage of Hours has power 5 or greater from any indefinite effect except +1/+1 counters, and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Sage of Hours.
1494-6113.description:
Deal combat damage using Sage of Hours.
Quilled Greatwurm triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2191-2770-6085.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Altanak an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

3394-4191-5010-5256.notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
3394-4191-5010-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Golgari Thug's power.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

1594-3532-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-2405-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Caller of the Claw, adding {C}{C}.
Caller of the Claw dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Caller of the Claw from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Caller of the Claw enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token for each nontoken creature that died under your control this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Bear, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2872-3525-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Clever Conjurer.
Utopia Sprowl attached to a basic Forest you control.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
2872-3525-5227.description:
Activate the Forest with Utopia Sprowl attached, adding at least {G}.
Utopia Sprowl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

1486-3525-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura and Paradise Mantle attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
1486-3525-4474.description:
Activate Magda by tapping it, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat for infinite Treasure tokens.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you can use them to activate Magda's ability to put all artifacts and Dragons in your library onto the battlefield.

1069-3661-4050-5222.description:
Cast Shield Sphere.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Shield Sphere for {0}.
Sacrifice Shield Sphere to Phyrexian Altar to add a mana of any color.
